newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps mostly flat, fuel and mogas down $1.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps mostly flat, fuel and mogas down $1.

text.p: European oil swaps were little changed on Wednesday, apart from fuel oil and gasoline which eased slightly, traders said.
Brent crude CFDs held steady at 10 cents under july for next week falling to 16 cents under and 19 cents under in the two subsequent weeks.

Gas oil was little changed although some dealers expected premiums for physical to weaken over the next few days. The crack spread against Brent held at 44.25 a barrel for the third quarter and $4.90 for the fourth.
Premiums for EN590 remain broadly flat at $9.75 a tonne for June and $9.50 for July.

Heavy fuel swaps slipped $1 a tonne to $83 for June but remained steeply contangoed up to $96 in February next year. Low sulphur cargo swaps also slipped but the physical market remained thin keeping swaps activity slight.
Gasoline swaps also slipped $1 a tonne to $208 for June, July $202 and August a further $2.50 lower.
Naphtha was also slow, but showed modest gains of 50 cents or so with June around $191.50.
